subject: ART-RIVER user style correction: hold flat surfaces as internal candidates
body: Received Sam correction via scrum-river-style-correction.md. Flat straight/bend batch preserved, not accepted visual direction. Do not integrate them as final raised map appearance. Art writer is testing adaptation of existing painted straight and prioritising matching rich bend; joined raised composition with real painted earth sides will follow. Current registered kit has exact shared mouth collars from re-used generated paint and all24rotation joins prepared, but crosshatch reflections and flat final appearance explicitly not accepted by Sam. Builder continues stations; art writer does not edit global files or topology.
